note.checkQuestion: Name one way to protect your information on a digital platform.
note.title: Best Practices in Online Behavior
steps: Think before posting and keep private details out of public posts.
Be careful with emails from unknown senders; do not open harmful links or attachments.

written.text: Q11.2. Describe the steps you should take to ensure the safe operation of digital platforms and devices.
written.finalAnswer: Think before sharing, use strong unique passwords, review privacy settings, be cautious with unknown emails, and download apps only from trusted sources.

modelAnswer: Think before posting on social media and avoid sharing personal information such as your home address or phone number publicly.
Be cautious when opening emails from unknown senders because they may contain harmful links or attachments.
Use strong, unique passwords to protect your online accounts.
Do not share sensitive information, such as passwords or financial details, through cloud storage.
Download online applications only from trusted sources such as Google Play Store or Apple App Store.
Review and update privacy settings regularly to control who can see your information.
These steps help protect your information and support the safe use of digital platforms and devices.

examTips: This section can be tested with short questions asking for safe practices on social media, email, cloud services, apps, or privacy settings.
For a short answer, give the reason and one practical action, such as not sharing a home address publicly.
For a longer answer, organize your response by platform and include several clear safety steps.
Use the textbook's key terms accurately: strong, unique passwords; privacy settings; trusted sources; and harmful links or attachments.

explain.title: Use digital platforms responsibly
explain.body: Social media, email, cloud services, and online applications are useful, but they should be used carefully. Think before posting, be cautious with unknown emails, protect cloud accounts, and choose trusted sources for apps.

explain.title: Protect personal information
explain.body: Avoid sharing personal details such as your home address or phone number publicly. Do not share sensitive information, such as passwords or financial details, through cloud storage.

explain.title: Privacy settings and data security
explain.body: Privacy settings and data security measures are essential tools that help protect your personal information while using digital platforms. Review settings regularly so you can control who sees your information.

explain.title: Secure your accounts
explain.body: Data security measures help protect your information from unauthorized access. Use strong, unique passwords for your online accounts instead of easy-to-guess passwords.

mistakes: Posting your home address or phone number publicly.
Opening links or attachments in emails from unknown senders without checking them.
Using weak or repeated passwords instead of strong, unique passwords.
Sharing passwords or financial details through cloud storage.
Setting privacy options once and never reviewing them again.
